processing: Cropped to the printed plate only (paper margin trimmed off all 4 sides, ~65px at full resolution, since the hand-drawn border is not perfectly straight and a sliver of margin paper otherwise bleeds in at a few points), then cropped narrower still on the right (v2, per Jonas's review of v1: the plate was too small in the poster) to enlarge the massif and the left slope -- this drops the moon and the 'F.V.' label box out of frame; the left slope (most of the gold cuts) and 'LA JUNGFRAU.' stay intact. Resampled to 3840x3119 (the resolution mark-detection is run at). Recoloured in the poster render (not in this committed file) toward a deep near-black ink and a warm cream paper, with a gold second-block overprint on 861 of Vallotton's own white knife cuts (stars + grass flecks), found by connected-component analysis of the thresholded plate -- never drawn.
